$purpose: Golden bytes for CTH1 streams, CTT1 v2 frames, CTHF headers, discovery tags and
Flow A QR fp. Every client that implements history transfer reads this file.
A byte change is a PR 1 amendment first, vectors second, code third.

$keys.comment: The only place these test keys exist. Seeds are in scripts/gen_history_crypto/src/main.rs.

vectors.name: payload_len_over_cap
vectors.note: payload_len > 512 MiB; decoder must not allocate

vectors.name: ctt1_v2_opening
vectors.note: signature verifies with tag ctt1v2-s, fails without

vectors.name: ctt1_v2_opening_ed25519_only
vectors.note: ML-DSA half is zeros; hybrid_verify must fail

vectors.name: ctt1_v2_opening_zero_kem_ct
vectors.note: type 0x02 with 1568 zero kemCt is malformed

vectors.name: cthf_header
vectors.note: header verifies; chunk 0 opens with the derived key

vectors.name: media_blob_field_first
vectors.note: HistoryMediaBlob fields must come in order 1, 2, 3; a blob before media_id cannot be streamed

vectors.name: channel_key_both_salts
vectors.note: HKDF-SHA256(ecdh || kem_ss, salt, info = snapshot_id); nearby salt construct_transfer_v2, file salt construct_history_file_v1

vectors.name: cthf_file_stream
vectors.note: V23's header, then the sealed chunk stream and EOF; the blob crosses the chunk boundary and must arrive byte-exact

vectors.name: cthf_chunks_swapped
vectors.note: V27 with its first two sealed chunks (length prefix included) exchanged; chunk 0 must not open
